comment: The Haro v0.16 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.16 grows v0.15 by the last thing NARRATE could not do: tell a RUN. NARRATE gains TELLS, a template per event of a run -- `run` and `result` for a language that declares a RUN, any declaration kind that plays a construct of it (compute, collect, group, branch, iterate), and `ask`, `matched`, `ordered`, `cut`, `answer` for one that declares an ASK. A template fills the placeholders its event has (R2, R9), every brace closes (R7); an event is told once (R5); a key is an event of a RUN or an ASK this language declares (R3, R6) or a declaration playing a construct (R1, R4). A voice may now tell and say nothing: TELLS alone is a voice (A1), and one that does neither narrates nothing (R8, which is v0.13's R7 and still says so). Every v0.15 fixture still passes: v0.16 refuses nothing v0.15 accepted (A3).

accepts.name: a voice that TELLS a run, and says nothing: TELLS alone is a voice
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.16", GRAMMAR "0.16", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION aexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, add, mul], OPERANDS [number, text, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION collect AS (VERB "COLLECT", SEATS [into: name, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION group AS (VERB "GROUP", SEATS [into: name, by: aexpr, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION branch AS (VERB "BRANCH", SEATS [when: aexpr, then: [step], else: [step]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION iterate AS (VERB "ITERATE", SEATS [over: name, as: name, do: [step]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION step AS (OF [compute, collect, group, branch, iterate]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [step], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], COMPUTE [compute, into, value], COLLECT [collect, into, value], GROUP [group, into, by, value], BRANCH [branch, when, then, else], ITERATE [iterate, over, as, do]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (TELLS [run: "Running {algorithm} on {record}.", compute: "{name}: {into} is now {value}.", iterate: "{name}: {count} items of {over}, as {as}:", branch: "{name}: the {taken} steps, when {when}.", result: "{algorithm} answers {result}."]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a voice that TELLS a question: ask, matched, ordered, cut and answer, beside a SAYS
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.16", GRAMMAR "0.16", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, contains], OPERANDS [number, text, ref], ABSENT missing, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, order, limit]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [flow: "{name}"], TELLS [ask: "Asking {from}: {question}", matched: "{count} of the {total} rows match.", ordered: "Ordered by {field} {direction}.", cut: "Only the first {limit} are kept.", answer: "The answer is {count} row(s): {rows}"]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.15 voice is a v0.16 voice: a NARRATE of SAYS alone, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.16", GRAMMAR "0.16", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [till: "{name} holds {holds}"]) RATIONALE "x"
